scope: Independent source and synthetic ZIP/CLI controls; original archive unread

controls.name: Canonical base and candidate pins, eight unchanged function bodies, and original hard capacities
Source head and actual checkout merge are separate; original compact failure fields match every frozen pin
All fixed artifact/run/repository fields and expiration reject mismatches
Fixed failed status, checks, three clocks, no profile and unexecuted lifecycle fail closed on mutation
Duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite literals, invalid UTF-8 and concatenated metadata reject
Complete ZIP size/digest admission and exact two-member gzip/CRC round trip
Traversal, absolute/drive/backslash/NUL paths, normalized duplicates, symlinks and missing root members reject
Selected length/CRC/UTF-8, entry count, declared expansion, raw size, encryption and codec bounds reject
Only two selected members are inflated and the aggregate gzip rejection branch remains active
Repository/source push/attempt/workflow/event marker and fixed CLI argument gates reject before output files
Archive receiver writes only complete exact-size exact-digest bytes, with no early recovered output
CLI emits two complete meta/chunk/end streams that reconstruct exact raw bytes and preserve the failed diagnostic
A structurally valid archive with altered original failure creates no recovered files or success stream
Append-only standalone job preserves existing jobs, read-only permissions, marker and metadata-first official stream

fixturePinOverride: Only in-memory PIN size/digest and isolated OUT for synthetic CLI; candidate source file unchanged
gzipBranchFixture: Reduced in-memory limit only for rejection branch; production 8 MiB constant independently verified unchanged
